title: Owner re-records the guide clips and Welcome films and watches them
goal: Run npm run clips and npm run films on the GPU machine and say whether they look right
acceptance: Both recordings finish; check:media reports them current; the owner says they look right
privacy: The owner's reply is recorded without coordinates, addresses or private flight data
validation: The owner's dated reply in the record
escalation: A failure reopens the record with a failing case before any fix

effort.basis: Two browser recordings and a viewing; the machine needs Playwright's browser. Estimated 2026-11-26 from the record's scope at the harness 10.21.3 reconcile; no calibration samples exist yet (first hour estimates here). Estimate, not a measurement.
